# StandardsHub - LLM-Friendly Content Index

This file lists all markdown representations of accounting standards available on StandardsHub.
Agents can request these pages with `Accept: text/markdown` header.

## Frameworks

- IAS - International Accounting Standards (41 standards)
- IFRS - International Financial Reporting Standards (20 standards)
- IPSAS - International Public Sector Accounting Standards (61 standards)
- Ind AS - Indian Accounting Standards (40 standards)
- IFRS Sustainability - IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards (2 standards)
- IFRS Publications - IFRS Foundation Publications (4 standards)
- IFRS for SMEs - IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities (1 standards)
- US GAAP - U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (99 standards)
- UK GAAP - UK Generally Accepted Accounting Practice (8 standards)
- ASBE - Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (42 standards)
- ASPE - Accounting Standards for Private Enterprises (43 standards)
- IFRIC - IFRIC Interpretations (23 standards)
- SIC - SIC Interpretations (29 standards)
- ASBJ - Accounting Standards Board of Japan (46 standards)
- HGB - Handelsgesetzbuch (German Commercial Code) (39 standards)
- DRS - Deutsche Rechnungslegungsstandards (28 standards)

## Usage

To fetch a markdown version of any page:

```bash
curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://standardshub.in/usgaap/asc105
```

Or access the static markdown files directly:

```
https://standardshub.in/markdown/usgaap/asc105.md
https://standardshub.in/markdown/ias/ias1.md
```
